title: Long-horizon quantized variant stability: batching and accuracy heatmap probe
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: produce a reproducible throughput/latency + accuracy matrix for FP8 and INT8 variants across long-context workloads and a range of batching profiles. We want to identify failure modes where batching or microbursts amplify calibration drift (accuracy regressions) or create unacceptable tail latency for production SLOs. This ticket scopes the experiment, implements runner scripts, validates calibration configs, and produces artifacts (heatmaps, dashboards, and a short runbook of mitigations).
acceptance_criteria: Automated benchmark runner reproduces experiments for 3 model sizes (small/med/large) and two calibrations (FP8 curve, INT8 symmetric) on long-context sequences (4096, 8192).
Heatmaps produced: accuracy delta (vs float32) and p95 latency plotted across batch sizes [1,2,4,8,16] and kv-cache warmup window [0,64,256,1024].
Documented cases where accuracy regresses >3% (relative) compared to float32 including config that triggered it and suggested mitigations.
PR with benchmark code and baseline datasets merged into internal repo and CI job that can replay the key experiment is green.
Short runbook with recommended defaults for Dedicated and Hosted SLOs: batch size caps, warmup heuristics, fallback policy for model variants.
Bench dashboard links and raw metrics uploaded to the perf-bench S3 path referenced in artifacts.
steps: Design experiment matrix: models = [redwood-7b, redwood-30b, redwood-70b], contexts = [4096,8192], batch_sizes = [1,2,4,8,16], warmup_windows = [0,64,256,1024], quant_modes = [FP8, INT8, FP32 baseline].
Prepare calibration artifacts: run calibration pipeline with representative prompt corpus (50k tokens per model) and save quant profiles to gs://redwood-quant/calib/ENG-99421/.

Implement benchmark runner: parallel workers that simulate production traffic with microburst patterns (Poisson arrivals + deterministic burst of 50 reqs over 200ms) and continuous KV cache reuse. Report tokens/s, latency p50/p95/p99, and accuracy metrics (EM, exact match / rouge-like score) vs float32 baseline.
Run a small pilot (1 GPU) to sanity-check configs and catch catastrophic failures before cluster runs.
Schedule full sweep on dedicated test cluster (24 GPUs) with experiment orchestration and telemetry collection (prometheus + jaeger + perf-bench exporter).
Analyze results: produce heatmaps, tail-latency CDFs, and accuracy-vs-batch scatterplots. Identify configurations to block or recommend.
Write runbook and open PR with benchmark code, calibration artifacts, and dashboards. Notify Runtime/Serving teams for rollout consideration.
comments: 2025-02-14 - Ava Chen: Created ticket and initial experiment matrix. Assigned to Diego for implementation. Goal is to finish sweep by end of Feb for runtime-1.20 decisions.

2025-02-16 - Diego Martinez: Pilot run on redwood-7b FP8 showed a systematic 2.8% drop in next-token accuracy for batch sizes >=8 when warmup_window=0. Suspect prefix quant noise accumulating in KV cache. Re-ran with warmup_window=256 and accuracy gap reduced to 0.7%.

2025-02-17 - Diego Martinez: Implemented microburst arrival generator and added p99 tail-latency measurement. Pilot indicates p99 spikes for INT8 at batch=16 with long-context (8192) due to repeated dequant/decompress on KV lookup. Needs profiling in runtime.

2025-02-18 - SRE review (Priya Rao): Recommend limiting default batch cap to 8 for long-context sessions in Hosted until mitigation is in runtime. Added ENG-100032 as follow-up for runtime-level kernel fusion investigation.
2025-02-20 - Diego Martinez: Full sweep scheduled on 2025-02-21 on test-cluster-quant. Using CI job 'quant-sweep-ENG-99421' to kick off. Uploading calibration artifacts to GCS.
